title: Onboard orion-alpha-13b v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and automate changelog
author: Lina Morales
release_notes: Added onboarding metadata and performance profiles for orion-alpha-13b v1.0; automated changelog entry generation and validation.
description: Context: Onboard orion-alpha-13b v1.0 to the model registry and introduce automated changelog generation for model releases. Motivation: Provide validated metadata, baseline performance profiles, and automatic release notes so downstream services and customers have reliable expectations for latency, memory footprint, and recommended quantization. What I changed: added models/orion-alpha-13b/metadata.yaml with canonical fields (name, version, architecture, tokenizer, provenance, license), added models/orion-alpha-13b/perf_profiles.json with P50/P95 latency across representative batch sizes and seq lengths, added scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py which templates changelog entries from metadata+perf_profiles and validates against existing CHANGELOG.md, added ci/perf-changelog.yml CI job to run generation+validation, updated docs/models/orion-alpha.md with usage examples, added tests/tests_model_registry/test_changelog_generation.py. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata - [x] Add performance profiles - [x] Add changelog generator and CI job - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Update docs and examples. Notes: perf-suite reported a ~6% regression on 8k-context runs on a low-memory A100 config; added a tolerance and mapping to recommend a larger instance or int4+fp16 fallback. See Linear ENG-4982 for rollout/canary plan.
